title: Policy Document Reference
description: Pointer to a single policy or contract document the vendor publishes (Terms of Service, Privacy Policy, DPA, subprocessor list, security overview).

url.description: Canonical URL for the document on the vendor's site.

last_checked.description: Date this entry was last checked against the live vendor URL (ISO 8601).

last_modified_observed.description: Last-modified or 'effective' date as published by the vendor on the page itself, if available.

language.description: ISO 639-1 two-letter language code of the linked document.

archive_url.description: Snapshot URL (e.g. Wayback Machine) of the document at last_checked date.

notes.description: Free-form notes (Markdown allowed) about the document.
